summary: GE Aerospace filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive agreement to acquire Consolidated Precision Products (CPP), a manufacturer of highly engineered castings, for an all-cash purchase price of $11.75 billion subject to closing adjustments. The deal was announced via press release and investor presentation on September 8, 2026, and is expected to close in the second half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions. No board recommendation or financial advisor was named. The long regulatory clock and sizable cash outlay frame the risk-arb watch: antitrust review timing, financing, and any purchase-price adjustment mechanics.
